Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, November 22 · NFL Week 11 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 22, 7:16 PM ET

Brock Purdy has the highest SPAGS projection in the Vikings at 49ers DraftKings Showdown: 18.8 points at $10,800 FLEX, 28.2 at captain for $16,200. Across 100,000 simulations Purdy holds 69% of the winning-lineup credit.

Justin Jefferson has the largest captain share: 21.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Jefferson at captain. The model gives him 9.4 targets on 27.6 routes. Brock Purdy is the next captain in line, at 15.7%. The model has him running 4.0 times.

San Francisco is a 4.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.5 for the 49ers and 20 for the Vikings.

Behind Purdy and Jefferson, the next projections are Christian McCaffrey (17.8, $11,800), Kirk Cousins (14.8, $9,400) and George Kittle (12.9, $8,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 22, 7:16 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Justin Jefferson, MIN WR ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Justin Jefferson holds 21.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 18.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.4 targets on 27.6 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 18.2 points with a simulated floor of 4.9 and a ceiling of 40.8. He holds 56% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 21.5% as the captain and 34.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Brock Purdy, SF QB ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Brock Purdy holds 15.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,200 and the 18.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 28.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.0 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Purdy averaged 18.9 points with a simulated floor of 11.0 and a ceiling of 35.3. He holds 69% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.7% as the captain and 53.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Christian McCaffrey, SF RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Christian McCaffrey holds 15.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 17.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 12.9 carries and 4.7 targets. Across 100,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 35.5. He holds 55% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.0% as the captain and 40.0% in a FLEX spot.

Kirk Cousins, MIN QB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

He holds 48% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.2% as the captain and 41.4% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Kittle averaged 12.9 points with a simulated floor of 1.7 and a ceiling of 31.3. Across 100,000 simulations Evans averaged 11.0 points with a simulated floor of 3.7 and a ceiling of 22.7. He holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.2% as the captain and 28.3% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Pineiro averaged 8.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.5 and a ceiling of 17.5. He holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.8% as the captain and 34.9% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Jennings averaged 5.6 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 14.9. Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

Justin Jefferson holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 21.5%, ahead of Brock Purdy (15.7%) and Christian McCaffrey (15.0%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Vikings vs 49ers?

Build around George Kittle at captain with Brock Purdy, Christian McCaffrey and T.J. Hockenson at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (230 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,400 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

Brock Purdy leads the SPAGS model at 18.8 DraftKings points for $10,800 at FLEX, or 28.2 points at captain for $16,200.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Vikings vs 49ers Showdown?

Christian McCaffrey is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Eddy Pineiro (8.6 points at $4,600), Jauan Jennings (5.6 points at $3,200) and Will Reichard (7.7 points at $5,000).

What is the Vikings vs 49ers spread and total?

The 49ers are a 4.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 24.5 for the 49ers and 20 for the Vikings.
